ModMetaData.name: Killfeed - 1.7 Fix (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: WorldLeader
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a combat killfeed showing who killed whom. Click a notification to jump to the event, and optionally display the weapon icon.
This continued edition includes a dedicated RimWorld 1.7 fix for pawns held in containers such as holding platforms. Their deaths no longer trigger fog-check null-reference errors or disappear from the feed.
添加战斗击杀信息，显示谁击杀了谁；点击通知可跳转到事件位置，并可选择显示武器图标。
本续作版包含独立的 RimWorld 1.7 修复：收容平台等容器内的 Pawn 不再因没有地图而触发迷雾判断空引用，相关死亡信息也不会因此丢失。
Original author: Kahdeg. Based on and modified from ChJees's work. 原作者：Kahdeg（キャデグ）。本 Mod 基于 ChJees 的作品修改。
